title: In setOemUnlockAllowedByUser of OemLockService.java, there is a possible way to bypass FRP due to a… (CVE-2026-58989)
description: A vulnerability in the setOemUnlockAllowedByUser method of OemLockService.java allows bypassing Factory Reset Protection (FRP) due to a missing permission check. This flaw enables local privilege escalation without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
